Our Founding

Born from Passion

Born from a deep-rooted passion for textiles in India, Reshmi Sangam was founded with a singular vision: to share the unparalleled beauty of Indian silk with the world.

We have grown from a local artisan collective into a globally recognized export house, upholding Quality, Integrity, and Partnership.

Mission & Values

Our Mission is Clear

Authentic Craftsmanship

Each thread tells a story of tradition, woven by skilled artisans who have honed their craft over generations.

Uncompromising Quality

Only the finest mulberry silk with strict quality controls to ensure a luxurious and durable product every time.

Ethical & Sustainable

Committed to fair-trade practices and sustainable sourcing that supports our artisan communities.

Global Trade

Export & Compliance

A transparent guide to our seamless global export process.

Our Export Process

01

Inquiry & Quotation

Submit your requirements. We prepare a detailed proforma invoice with specs, pricing, payment terms, and delivery timeline.

02

Order Confirmation

Confirm the order and we proceed with production scheduling using standard international trade payment methods.

03

Production & QC

Your order enters production with rigorous quality control at each stage from raw silk through to finished product.

04

Packaging & Documentation

Fabrics rolled on sturdy tubes and wrapped in waterproof layers. All export documentation prepared accurately.

05

Shipping & Delivery

Dispatched via trusted freight partners with real-time tracking until delivery worldwide.

Key Documentation

📋
Importer Exporter Code (IEC)

Mandatory 10-digit code for businesses exporting from India.

🧾
GST Registration

Required for all businesses operating within India to handle taxation.

📜
RCMC Certificate

Issued by an Export Promotion Council, validates our exporter credentials.

📦
Commercial Invoice & Packing List

Details the transaction and shipment contents for customs.

🌐
Certificate of Origin

Certifies that the goods are produced or manufactured in India.

Our Craft

How We Sew Silk

A step-by-step guide to our meticulous silk sewing process.

1

Fabric Selection

We choose the finest silk, pre-wash and gently iron it to perfection before any work begins.

2

Workspace Setup

Our workspace is kept immaculate to protect delicate silk fabric at every stage.

3

Precise Cutting

Silk is cut in a single layer using sharp scissors and precision tools.

4

Machine Setup

Machines adjusted with fine needles (60/8 or 70/10) and proper silk thread tension.

5

Expert Sewing

Slow, steady pace — avoiding backstitching for a smooth luxurious finish.

6

Securing Seams

Seams secured by hand-knotting and weaving threads for lasting durability.

7

Finishing Edges

We serge or sew French seams to prevent fraying and maintain integrity.

8

Hemming

Hand-roll or machine hem for a luxurious, professional finish.

9

Final Press & Care

Gently pressed and properly folded for immaculate storage and presentation.

Every Artist's Gift

True craftsmanship lies in the details. From the finest silk to the final press, every step is handled with care to create a product of unparalleled quality and luxury.
